title: Inflatable Sleeping Pad TPU – Ultralight Sleeping Mat for Camping
descriptionHtml:
Sleeping badly on hard, cold ground?

A thin sleeping pad lets every single stone through and draws the cold straight up from the ground. You wake up stiff, frozen and unusually tired – right in the middle of what was supposed to be a great camping trip.

A soft, warm bed – wherever you make camp

The inflatable TPU mat puts a thick, springy layer between you and the ground that insulates against the cold and evens out the surface. It inflates in a few breaths, is moisture-resistant and weighs next to nothing in your backpack.

Features

  • Ultralight TPU – barely noticeable in your pack.
  • Insulates against the cold – warmer, better sleep.
  • Quick inflation – ready in a few breaths.
  • Moisture-resistant – handles dew and wet ground.
  • Compact – rolled up, it fits anywhere.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
